findings.description: US-003 missing pre-swap parity check. Concurrent auto-memory writes between US-001 and US-003 could cause data loss when memory.bak is deleted.
findings.resolution: US-003 AC now requires Compare-Object (Name, Hash) parity check immediately before Rename-Item AND immediately before Remove-Item memory.bak. Halt on diff.

findings.description: Byte-identity check underspecified. Compare-Object on FileHashInfo objects compares Path field, which always differs.
findings.resolution: US-001 AC rewritten to build (Name, Hash) pscustomobjects explicitly and compare on those properties. Fallback to certutil/git hash-object documented.

findings.description: Junction recipe in docs/fork-notes.md unsafe — rmdir+mklink two-liner contradicts the safer US-003 backup-first flow and would tempt a future operator to wipe user-dir before verifying.
findings.resolution: docs/fork-notes.md recipe now mirrors the full safe flow: backup → compare → junction → verify → delete backup.

findings.description: AGENTS.md describes the happy fork; adding ## Auto-memory without scope language could mislead happy-side readers into thinking memories apply to happy-app/server.
findings.resolution: Section title now `## Auto-memory (codexu bookkeeper-scope)` with explicit codexu-bookkeeper / ralph-pipeline scope intro. CLAUDE.md mirror gets same scope tag.

findings.description: Moving per-developer memory into tracked git history is a privacy boundary change; no secret/privacy scan required before commit.
findings.resolution: US-001 AC adds mandatory pre-commit privacy/secret scan with explicit checks for metadata.originSessionId and any embedded paths/tokens.

findings.description: plans/codexu-roadmap.md:851-853 stale user-dir reference left deferrable. Active operating manual; misleads future readers about source of truth.
findings.resolution: Promoted into US-002 (not deferred). US-002 AC + commit message include the file.

findings.description: Gitignored CLAUDE.md change can't be verified by git; no handoff mechanism specified.
findings.resolution: US-002 AC mandates the impl member emit the post-edit Select-String '## Auto-memory' output in its mailbox report.

findings.description: Fresh-session smoke test too vague — 'recall a memory by slug' doesn't name a slug or expected text.
findings.resolution: US-003 AC now names feedback_phase_discipline_separate_members as the test slug and requires response to mention 'one fresh ralph member per phase' or equivalent 'never chain phases' guidance.

findings.description: '18 files' vs '17 entries' phrasing inconsistent; risks implementer confusion.
findings.resolution: Standardized to '18 files = MEMORY.md index + 17 memory entries' across acceptance criteria.

findings.description: US-003 multi-step manual recipe; idempotent PowerShell script would reduce risk.
findings.resolution: Deferred — inline AC checklist now mirrors safe sequence. Script is nice-to-have but adds maintenance burden. Operator can author one out-of-band if desired.
